items.pattern: to + verb after keep/enjoy/avoid/finish/mind/suggest (kept to throw)
items.sk: Po tomto slovese patrí Gerund (-ing): „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po tomto slovesu patří Gerund (-ing): „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: This verb is followed by a Gerund (-ing): “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: base verb after keep/enjoy/finish (kept throw)
items.sk: Po tomto slovese treba tvar s -ing (Gerund): „{right}“.
items.cz: Po tomto slovesu je potřeba tvar s -ing (Gerund): „{right}“.
items.en: This verb needs the -ing form (Gerund): “{right}”.

items.pattern: -ing after refuse/manage/decide/want/hope/promise (refused leaving)
items.sk: Po tomto slovese patrí Infinitive s „to“: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po tomto slovesu patří Infinitive s „to“: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: This verb is followed by “to” + verb: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: base verb without to after refuse/manage/decide (managed stay)
items.sk: Chýba „to“: po tomto slovese patrí Infinitive: „{right}“.
items.cz: Chybí „to“: po tomto slovesu patří Infinitive: „{right}“.
items.en: “to” is missing; this verb takes the Infinitive: “{right}”.

items.pattern: past form after to (to left, to stayed)
items.en: After “to” use the base form: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: preposition + to/base verb (before to leave, interested in learn)
items.en: After a preposition use the Gerund: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: look forward to / be used to + base verb (look forward to see)
items.en: Here “to” is a preposition, so -ing follows: “{right}”.

items.pattern: with/of added after finish/stop/start (finished with wrapping)
items.sk: Gerund ide po tomto slovese priamo, bez predložky: „{right}“.
items.cz: Gerund jde po tomto slovesu přímo, bez předložky: „{right}“.
items.en: The Gerund follows this verb directly, no preposition: “{right}”.

items.pattern: -ing and to swapped after stop/remember/forget/try, changing the meaning
items.sk: Tvar mení význam („stop -ing“ = prestať, „stop to“ = zastaviť sa, aby): „{right}“.
items.cz: Tvar mění význam („stop -ing“ = přestat, „stop to“ = zastavit se, aby): „{right}“.
items.en: The form changes the meaning (“stop -ing” = quit, “stop to” = pause to): “{right}”.

items.pattern: let/make + person + to + verb (made her to wait)
items.sk: Po „let/make“ + osoba patrí base form bez „to“: „{right}“.
items.cz: Po „let/make“ + osoba patří base form bez „to“: „{right}“.
items.en: After “let/make” + person use the base form, no “to”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: want + that-clause copied from chcieť, aby (wanted that she stays)
items.en: “want” doesn't take “that”: use “want” + person + “to”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: succeeded to + verb for podarilo sa (succeeded to stay)
items.en: “succeed” doesn't take “to” (it's “succeed in -ing”); use “{right}”.

items.pattern: still + verb for kept doing (She still threw)
items.en: Repeating an action is “keep” + -ing: “{right}”.

items.pattern: stopped for finished/completed (She stopped wrapping)
items.sk: „Stopped“ znamená prestať aj uprostred; dokončenie vyjadruje „{right}“.
items.cz: „Stopped“ znamená přestat i uprostřed; dokončení vyjadřuje „{right}“.
items.en: “stopped” can mean halfway; completing it is “{right}”.

items.pattern: was able to / could for podarilo sa
items.en: “{right}” says “it worked out” most exactly.

items.pattern: didn't want to instead of refused to (weaker meaning, same structure type)
items.en: “{right}” expresses the meaning more exactly than “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: negative verb after until copied from Slovak/Czech (until it didn't feel smooth)
items.en: No negative after “until”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: adverb after feel/look/seem (felt smoothly)
items.en: After “feel/look/seem” use an adjective: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: article dropped before a singular countable noun (pillow for a pillow)
items.sk: Pred počítateľným podstatným menom v jednotnom čísle chýba člen: „{right}“.
items.cz: Před počitatelným podstatným jménem v jednotném čísle chybí člen: „{right}“.
items.en: A singular countable noun needs an article: “{right}”.

items.pattern: wrong, extra or missing preposition copied from Slovak/Czech (struck into, on place)
items.en: The correct phrase is “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.
